observed: The official ETH laboratory page embeds video Epv37KSi0Io. Its 1280 x 720 thumbnail shows a cream benchtop instrument with a CFX96 Touch-like label, rounded closed hood, dark horizontal seam, sloped display and side vent panel.
The same image shows yellow-capped tubes in a rack, a cylinder, cabinets and stacked trays. A person obscures part of the scene; this view does not establish a floor plan.

published_dimensions_m.basis: Manufacturer Bulletin 6075, system dimensions table, page 1. Used only as an exterior size reference.

implemented: A separate closed cream instrument exterior on four contact-capable feet, with a rounded hood, dark seam, sloped display and side-panel trim.
The existing generic filter-access mechanism remains separate. The photographed cream device is not identified as an aerosol sampler.
inferred: The device location, feet, display dimensions, cover profiles and panel details are authored estimates. This original exterior is not OEM CAD or an exact installed-device replica.
The whole-room arrangement remains a workflow-based design, without a measured ETH floor plan or complete inventory.
unresolved: The fixed context asset has no opening, pickup or operating interface; only exterior contact is modeled.
Additional apparatus and room views are still needed to qualify reference fidelity and installation clearances.
eth_air_quality.media_policy: The source image remains local inspection evidence. No photograph, logo, brand label or OEM mesh is embedded or redistributed.
